en: A multi-view postcard featuring six images of notable landmarks and cityscapes from Brașov. The images include a medieval church with mountains in the background, a grand classical building with a garden and vintage car, a central square with a clock tower, a hillside with villas and an Orthodox church, a view of the city framed by an arch, and a modernist office building with 1960s-70s cars. The word 'BRAȘOV' is prominently displayed in the center.
